CANONICAL_NAME.value: L1 adaptive control basic simulation (Hovakimyan & Cao's L1 architecture on a first-order plant with unknown parameters), MATLAB, run under Octave

VERSION.value: github.com/xkhainguyen/L1AC-Basics main (commit in hashes): MainL1_ODE1_v1.m, MainL1_ODE1_v2.m

value.lineage: L1 adaptive control (Cao & Hovakimyan, 2006-; book 2010): a state predictor, a fast projection-based adaptation law, and a low-pass filter on the control channel that decouples adaptation rate from robustness -- the adaptive architecture flown on NASA's AirSTAR and in quadrotor augmentation. This is a minimal simulation of the architecture (MATLAB, 2022) whose author later published L1 augmentation for geometric quadrotor control.

value.built_to: adapt fast to an unknown plant without the high-gain fragility of classical MRAC, by filtering the adaptive control signal
value.pressure: unknown/time-varying plant with robustness requirements (flight control)
value.success_means: the plant tracks the reference; the adaptive estimate moves; the filtered control stays smooth

value.pressure: parametric uncertainty under a hard robustness margin
value.failure_condition: loss of robustness under fast adaptation (the MRAC failure L1 was designed against; Rohrs 1985)
